relationship: sender leads the team; note goes to the team channel and as a printed card

quote.text: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.

body: In the spring we set ourselves a goal that sounded a little unreasonable: move every simulation run onto the new farm before the end of the year, without stopping anyone's work along the way.

We got there in October. Test runs that used to take a week now finish the same afternoon. That happened because of late nights nobody asked for, careful reviews, and one habit you kept no matter what: no one debugs alone.
Three other teams now run their tests on what you built, and I'm carrying that same habit into every group I work with.
This Thanksgiving I'm grateful for every one of you who touched this, on-site and remote.

channel_post: Happy Thanksgiving, team. In the spring we set a goal that sounded a little unreasonable: every simulation run on the new farm by year's end, without stopping anyone's work. We got there in October, and test runs that took a week now finish the same afternoon. That came from late nights nobody asked for, careful reviews, and the habit you kept no matter what: no one debugs alone. Three other teams now build on what you made, and I'm taking that habit everywhere I go. Grateful for every one of you who touched this, on-site and remote. 🧡
